Frozen cross-language golden for the BidAwardEnvelope award_hash binding. award_hash = "0x"+hex(keccak256(utf8(domain_separator 
 payment_id 
 quote_hash 
 settler_id))). The Go binding (bindings/go/award-hash, ComputeAwardHash) and the TS port (bindings/typescript/award-hash, computeAwardHash) BOTH assert their output equals these values; matching this file on both sides means they match each other. award_hash is signature-binding (the proof.challenge of an award-authority VP), NOT an identifier. Regenerate per conformance/README.md and bump the domain_separator "v1" suffix only if the preimage layout changes.
